dogecoin.text: Do I believe $doge will hit a dollar? Absolutely. Will $doge still be around during the next bull run? Not a chance. Anyways keeping FOMO-ing into it, my shorts will be ready 😉

BTC is deflationary which tackles the problem with fiat, ETH has smart contracts and ADA processes over 1Mil transactions per second. What’s the USP of $doge ? Limited use case, not much institutional backing and an unlimited supply which causes it to have no store of value
